parameters.name: AttackInstance
parameters.description: The attacked asset. You can specify the instance name, public IP address, or private IP address.

parameters.name: AttackType
parameters.description:
The attack type. Valid values:
- 9: SQL Server brute-force attacks
- 5: SSH brute-force attacks
- 6: RDP brute-force attacks
- 101: Java Struts2 attack blocked
- 102: Redis attack blocked
- 103: China Chopper (AntSword) WebShell communication
- 104: China Chopper WebShell communication
- 133: XISE WebShell communication
- 161: WebShell upload
- 209: PHP WebShell upload
- 210: JSP WebShell upload
- 211: ASP WebShell upload
- 215: Special extension WebShell upload
- ai_webshell: WebShell upload intelligent defense
- java_common_rce: Java common remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability blocked
- alinet_webrce: Adaptive web attack defense

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return in a paged query.

parameters.name: DstPort
parameters.description: The Attack Target Ports of the Attack Target.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The timestamp of the end time.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The timestamp of the start time.

This field is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
